scientific_question: Within the already-frozen independent network-context robustness block, which predeclared lineage and realized local-network descriptors distinguish sign rescue from attenuation-only or worsening when global opportunity declines?
analysis_subset: Lineages with global island-minus-mainland opportunity < 0 and support-OFF reproduction < 0. No empirical system or outcome is used to select lineages.

predeclared_outcome_classes.attenuation_only: support-ON delta is greater than support-OFF delta but remains < 0
predeclared_outcome_classes.worsening: support-ON delta is less than support-OFF delta
predeclared_outcome_classes.other_no_material_change: all remaining cases under floating-point sign epsilon only

descriptor_definitions.active_context_fraction: fraction of the four realized local contexts in which the lineage retains a positive interaction row
descriptor_definitions.positive_partner_count: number of positive visitor links in the realized local row
descriptor_definitions.row_shannon: Shannon entropy of positive realized interaction weights after normalizing a lineage row to sum one; zero for empty/single-link rows
descriptor_definitions.dominant_partner_share: largest normalized interaction weight in a positive lineage row; zero when no positive row exists

summary_rule: Report class counts and class-specific means for every predeclared descriptor. Also report sign-rescue minus worsening and sign-rescue minus attenuation-only mean contrasts. Do not search additional descriptors after seeing class separation.
decision_rule: If sign-rescue cases differ consistently from worsening on one or more predeclared realized-network descriptors, use only those declared descriptors as empirical measurement priorities; do not call them causal.
If initial trait or dependency separates classes, retain that as a synthetic interaction with network context but do not infer an empirical moderator.
If no clear descriptor separates classes, keep network context as a replicated but underidentified branch allocator rather than inventing a hidden state variable.
forbidden: change the parent seed block or support strength after seeing the result
add descriptor variables after outcome-class inspection
fit a classifier and report in-sample accuracy as mechanism proof
map a synthetic descriptor to Guaiacum, Nicotiana, Hawaiʻi or Izu without source-native matched measurements
drop worsening cases from the analysis
claim_boundary: This is a synthetic discriminator analysis nested in an already-frozen robustness block. It can prioritize empirical network measurements but cannot establish why any real island system buffers or worsens.
